data_product_name: Advanced Service Flu report - Pharmacy Contractors
data_product_description: This report tracks flu vaccination activity delivered by pharmacy contractors under the Advanced Service. Enables monitoring of uptake and performance across community pharmacy providers.
data_product_overview:
## Access information
To gain access to 'Catalyst', you will be required to input an ID and password:
ID - NHSBSAGuest
Password - Password12345
If the password is locked for any reason the system automatically reinstates the password. This may take up to 20 minutes.

Note that your browser may give you warning that this is part of a data breach. As this is a publicly available user name and password you do not need to take any action and can login using the provided generic user ID and password.

## About this dashboard
Monthly information on the number of flu vaccines administered by pharmacy contractors under the community pharmacy seasonal influenza vaccination advanced service.

- Advance Service Flu Report - Pharmacy Contractors

The report is now available via our Open Data Portal (ODP) for the current season and historic seasons from 2015 onwards.

The report includes:
- data relating to NHS England Area
- pharmacy details
- vaccine name
- manufacturer
- quantity
- drug cost
- fee cost
